architecture_scope: One clean detached Release worldserver configure/build and gate-bearing receipt only.
gate_state: Complete runtime lineage has independent GO; one build is authorized before post-build resealing and Stage 3.

first_broken_edge.cause: The only existing worldserver binary predates the native GUID and controller repairs.

scope_lock.objective: Produce one hash-verified build_ready handoff for the exact clean authorization commit or one typed build failure.
scope_lock.expected_observable_change: A new gate-bearing worldserver binary contains the reviewed runtime lineage.
scope_lock.stop_condition: Any preflight mismatch stops before configure; any configure/build failure consumes the only budget and stops without retry.

acceptance_conditions: Exact clean source, policy, configure, coordinated build, receipt, binary hash, and source completion snapshots verify.
No server, provision, database, live, or DVC action occurs.
forbidden: No source mutation, second build, old-build overwrite, server/live/DVC action, or retry.
next_action: Execute the exact one-build work unit in the source handoff.
